analysis.reasonEn: Current price $116.80 approaches the lower Bollinger Band ($108.75). RSI at 37.6 is entering oversold territory. MACD histogram at -1.6628 continues to worsen. ADX at 29.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (41.7) is significantly higher than +DI (12.3), suggesting downward pressure is dominant. The 5-day low ($103.41) is lower than the 20-day low ($103.41), forming a Lower Low pattern. The volume ratio of 0.80 to the 5-day average suggests subdued trading, hinting at potential weakening of the downtrend, but signals for a trend reversal are weak. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
